checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: All five strings correct in every variant
must.why: All five lines present and correct in all three.

must.item: Every line comfortably readable at delivered size
must.why: Readable, though 9:16 is small (352px wide) and the 1:1 and 16:9 secondary lines are smallish; the address is on a bar and clear.
Dark green on cream; no overlap with leaves.
16:9 left margin is tight (~38px) but not clipped. In 9:16 the address bar is wide with a modest margin.

must.item: Matching leafy imagery and styling, adapted layouts
must.why: Same cream/green palette and plants; layouts differ per format. 9:16 uses a serif font while the others use sans, a slight inconsistency.

faults.what: The 9:16 ad uses a serif typeface and a thin, small headline, while the 1:1 and 16:9 ads use bold sans-serif. The set looks less matched.
The 9:16 headline is small and light, and it is split differently from the other two (one line vs two).
The 16:9 text sits close to the left edge, and the plants are cropped at the right and bottom edges.
The 1:1 secondary lines are fairly small, and the 20% line is slightly off-centre.

summary: Three clean, correctly spelled green-and-cream ads in the right ratios with readable address bars; the main flaw is the 9:16 ad's different serif typeface and small headline, which weakens the set's consistency.
